description: Per-hobby correction layer applied after the base recipe. Supported scalar replacements: subject, environment, composition, camera, lighting, palette, visual_variant. Supported append arrays: emotion_add, recognition_anchors_add, must_include_add, avoid_add, override_prompt_additions. Use only after review/QA identifies a real need.

fashion.streetwear.subject: A young adult actively styling and wearing layered generic streetwear with distinctive silhouette, texture, sneakers, and accessories, with no visible brands or text
fashion.streetwear.environment: A clean contemporary urban setting with abstract architecture and color blocks only; no storefront names, posters, advertisements, signs, or readable environmental text
recognition_anchors_add: streetwear sneakers and accessories without logos
urban fashion context without commercial signage
must_include_add: clear fashion styling action or pose
background surfaces free of readable text
avoid_add: letters or words in the background
any real-world sneaker brand silhouette or trade dress
signature sole geometry associated with a known sneaker model
distinctive panel arrangement copied from a real sneaker
override_prompt_additions: Every garment, wall, storefront-like surface, poster-like surface, accessory, and background element must be completely free of readable words, letters, logos, brand marks, slogans, and pseudo-text. Where signage would normally appear, use blank material, abstract color blocks, or non-linguistic geometric patterns.

The footwear must be a generic, fictional, entirely unbranded sneaker design that is not recognisably derived from any real sneaker model or manufacturer: no signature sole geometry, no recognisable stripe layout, no swoosh-like mark, no three-stripe-like treatment, no distinctive panel arrangement, and no other trademark-like silhouette associated with a known shoe brand. Invent a plain, original shoe shape instead.

avoid_add: readable text of any kind on books
must_include_add: plain or abstract book covers and spines with no readable text
blank or non-linguistic page marks such as plain lines, dots, or abstract cover art only
visual identity carried by the physical books and the reading action, not by typography
override_prompt_additions: Every book cover, spine, and open page in this scene must be free of readable text: no title, no author name, no spine text, no invented words, no pseudo-publishing logo or imprint mark, and no poster/signage-style lettering anywhere. Book covers and spines should use plain colours, abstract patterns, simple non-linguistic ornament, or blank cloth/leather-like texture instead of typography. The scene must still clearly read as reading/books through physical book shapes, stacks, page texture, and an active reading gesture — not through any text on the books.

wellness.cold_plunge.subject: A person braced and alert in a cold plunge, submerged to the chest in visibly cold water with floating ice cubes, gripping the edge with a focused, invigorated expression
wellness.cold_plunge.environment: An outdoor cold-plunge or dedicated cold-therapy setting such as a winter garden, cold-spa deck, or ice-bath tub with frost/condensation on nearby surfaces, distinctly cold rather than steamy
recognition_anchors_add: visible ice cubes or floating ice in the water
condensation or frost on the tub rim or nearby surfaces
must_include_add: clearly cold water with visible ice
an alert, braced posture rather than a relaxed soak
a cold-plunge or cold-therapy context that is unmistakably not a hot bath
avoid_add: relaxed soaking pose with closed eyes
sauna or hot-spring signage or architecture
override_prompt_additions: This must read unmistakably as a COLD plunge, not a warm bath or onsen: the water must look cold (clear, faintly blue-tinted, with visible floating ice cubes), any visible breath or vapor should read as cold-air breath rather than warm steam, and the person's expression and posture should be alert, braced, and invigorated rather than relaxed and melting into the water. Do not render rising steam, glowing warm light in the water, or a serene eyes-closed soaking pose — those read as a hot spring, which is the opposite of this hobby.

recognition_anchors_add: generic unbranded skate shoes with plain, original sole and upper construction
skateboard deck and trucks free of any logo or wordmark
must_include_add: plain, stylish, entirely unbranded skate shoes
a skateboard deck and hardware with no readable graphics, logos, or brand marks
avoid_add: readable brand text on footwear or deck
pseudo-brand mark on footwear or deck
any real-world sneaker brand silhouette or trade dress
signature sole geometry associated with a known sneaker model
recognisable skateboard deck graphic or brand logo
override_prompt_additions: The skate shoes must be a plain, generic, entirely unbranded design: invent an original sole tread, upper panel layout, and silhouette rather than reproducing any real skate-shoe brand's construction. No swoosh-like mark, no checkmark-like mark, no three-stripe-like treatment, no signature side-panel shape, no manufacturer badge, and no readable text anywhere on the shoes. The skateboard deck and trucks must likewise carry no readable logo, wordmark, or recognisable brand graphic. The shoes and board should still look stylish, well-designed, and true to real-world skate gear construction — not blank, sterile, or obviously censored.

avoid_add: letters or numbers on the game box
letters or numbers on the table
letters or numbers anywhere in the background
override_prompt_additions: The finished artwork must contain absolutely no title, no caption, no typography, and no readable words or labels anywhere in the image. The board, cards, game pieces, game box, table surface, walls, and any posters or background details must use only abstract, non-linguistic symbols, icons, and patterns — never letters, numbers, or words of any kind, including as a caption beneath or within the scene.

learning.philosophy.subject: Two or three young adults actively discussing a philosophical idea, with one person explaining or debating a concept while pointing to a contemporary notebook, annotated book, logic/argument diagram, concept map, or simple philosophical thought-experiment sketch
learning.philosophy.environment: A modern library, university study space, bright reading room, contemporary cafe, or campus discussion setting that supports lively intellectual conversation
recognition_anchors_add: active intellectual discussion between two or three people
a modern book or notebook with a concept diagram or argument sketch
gestures showing debate, explanation, or reasoning
a contemporary study or discussion setting
must_include_add: at least one modern book or notebook
an active discussion or reasoning gesture
a visual cue of ideas or argument structure such as a concept diagram or annotated notes
avoid_add: ancient scroll as the primary focus
antique leather-bound tome as the primary focus
override_prompt_additions: This is a scene of contemporary intellectual discussion, not historical research, archaeology, or the occult. The book or notebook shown must read as a modern, ordinary object with handwritten notes or a simple diagram — never as an ancient tome, grimoire, or mystical artifact. Keep the emotional tone 'knowledge is exciting': curious, animated, and engaging, never gloomy, solemn, or mysterious.

technology.ai.subject: A person actively exploring an abstract artificial-intelligence visualization made of glowing nodes, linked patterns, flowing data-like light, and model-like structures, without any readable interface
technology.ai.environment: A believable modern creative or research workspace where AI is represented through abstract light, nodes, diagrams, and spatial visualization rather than text-bearing screens
recognition_anchors_add: human actively interacting with an AI visualization
must_include_add: all interfaces free of readable text
override_prompt_additions: Do not render any readable interface copy. Any display or projection must contain only abstract shapes, nodes, light patterns, diagrams, and non-linguistic marks—no letters, words, numbers, code, slogans, logos, labels, captions, or pseudo-text.
